name: WE-055 home inspector licensing (expand-loop blind run)

a1.text: The requirements cost some current and would-be inspectors more than they would otherwise spend.

a2.text: Some incumbents who cannot be grandfathered train and sit the exam to stay in practice.

a3.text: Despite complaint-only enforcement, unlicensed practice is deterred for most inspections: agents' forms and lenders ask for the license number, and buyers and agents complain.

a8.text: Exempt engineers and unlicensed practice cannot replace the excluded supply at the old fee (the response is partial).

a12.text: Some near-line inspectors would otherwise fall short of 250 inspections by their application date, and can find extra jobs.

a27.text: Some inspectors carried no insurance before.

a33.text: Inspectors' cost per inspection does not fall below its counterfactual level as the number of inspectors falls (constant or rising cost).

s1.text: Inspectors and buyers know the Act's dates and expect the license to be required on them.

s2.text: Incumbents expect the grandfathering window to close on 31 December 2027 and not be reopened.
